messages:
alex: Heads-up — after the kernel-selection tweak last night, I see a subtle token-latency bump on short prompts for route=chat-small. Putting raw traces here for visibility.
priya: saw that in SLO alerts earlier, looked like a 6-8ms median shift?
alex: exactly. ran a few profiles, attached sample. main change appears when kernel_selector picks the tiled-atten kernel vs the fast-stream kernel during batch sizes <=4.
marta: can you paste the profiler snippet?
alex: sure — small copy:
```
profile: route=chat-small, seq=64, batch=3
kernel: tiled-attn -> setup 1.2ms, compute 9.8ms, kv-commit 2.3ms
alt-kernel: fast-stream -> setup 0.9ms, compute 8.7ms, kv-commit 0.6ms
```
alex: notice the kv-commit difference when tiled-attn used, KV commit latency spikes ~1.7ms per request in this path.
priya: interesting. is KV commit the prefix cache flush or the per-request memcpy into KV shard?
alex: looks like memcpy+shard lock contention. the tiled kernel forces slightly different ordering so we hit a hot index on shard-7.
infra-bot: Incident alert: token_latency_p50(route="chat-small") crossed 30ms at 2025-11-05T03:42:10Z — severity: low — linked runbook #kv-hotspots
sam: can we confirm reuse by route? maybe chat-small doesn't reuse prefixes so more memcpy per token?
priya: I pulled metric: per_route_prefix_reuse_rate{route="chat-small"} = 12% vs chat-long = 68%. low reuse + small batches = worse tail when kernel picks tiled path.
marta: ok — hypothesis: kernel_selector uses sequence-length threshold only, doesn't consider route-level reuse or shard hotness. we should add an override to bias toward fast-stream for low-reuse routes.
alex: agree. proposing two quick changes: 1) add per-token metric token_kernel_label to trace layer so dashboards can break down by kernel, 2) add a per-route kernel_bias config with rollout via console.
priya: for dashboards, request panels: token-level waterfall (setup/compute/kv-commit), kernel split p50/p95, per-route reuse histogram, and evictions by time-of-day.
sam: +1. also add KV memory footprint gauge per shard: kv_shard_mem_bytes{shard_id} so we can correlate evictions.
infra-bot: New config PR template: /ops/kernel-bias — please include canary percentage and fallback rule.
developer: quick nit — metric names suggestion:
```
runtime_token_latency_seconds_bucket
runtime_token_latency_components_seconds{component="setup|compute|kv_commit"}
runtime_token_kernel_label{kernel="fast-stream|tiled-attn"}
per_route_prefix_reuse_ratio
kv_shard_mem_bytes
```
marta: nice. who will own the instrumentation change? alex?
alex: I can prototype token_kernel_label and the component breakdown today. will instrument at the token emission boundary.
priya: I'll wire up Grafana panels after you push metrics — suggest a combined panel: stacked area by component, filter by kernel label and route.
sam: for immediate mitigation, can we hotpatch kernel_selector to prefer fast-stream for batch<=4 on routes with reuse_rate<20%?
alex: yes — simple server-side flag. will test in staging.
marta: add a tiny e2e in perf suite: simulate batch patterns and assert p50 delta < 3ms after patch.
alex: test results from staging: patched selector reduced p50 by 5ms for chat-small; kv_shard_mem_bytes unaffected; evictions decreased 8% over 1 hour.
priya: great. roll to canary 10% for 30m, watch token_kernel_label split.
infra-bot: Deploy started: kernel-bias-canary -> 10% -> tracker #2345
devops: reminder: add alert on kernel_switch_rate spike — we don't want oscillations.
alex: noted. also scheduling a short follow-up to discuss long-term: better kernel cost model in selector (latency+kv-cost+cache-heat).
marta: SGTM. schedule 30m sync at 16:00 PT?
priya: works for me.
alex: thanks — will push PR and post link here when ready. :thumbsup:
